informal: My card's blocked, what's going on?
standard: My card has been blocked. Can you help me?
formal: I have noticed that my bank card has been blocked and would be grateful if you could investigate.

informal: My head and throat are killing me.
standard: I've had a headache and a sore throat since yesterday.
formal: I have been suffering from a headache and a sore throat since yesterday, doctor.

informal: The heating's gone off again, can you come look?
standard: The heating isn't working in the flat.
formal: I am writing to inform you that the heating in the flat is broken and would appreciate a prompt repair.

informal: Mind turning the music down a bit?
standard: Could you turn the music down a little? It's late.
formal: I would be grateful if you could lower the volume of the music at this late hour.

informal: My bag never showed up, what a pain!
standard: My suitcase hasn't arrived. What should I do?
formal: My luggage has not been delivered, and I wish to file a lost baggage report.

standard: Excuse me, my meal is cold. Could you heat it up?
formal: I regret to inform you that my meal arrived cold; would you kindly replace it?

standard: Thanks for the invitation, but I won't be able to come.
formal: Thank you for your kind invitation; unfortunately, I am unable to accept.

tr: bu konuda geri bildirimin var mı?
informal: What do you reckon? Any thoughts?
standard: Do you have any feedback on my work?
formal: I would greatly appreciate your feedback on this document.

informal: Can we push the deadline back?
standard: Would it be possible to extend the deadline?
formal: Would it be feasible to extend the deadline by a few days?

informal: Hey, which way's the town hall?
standard: Excuse me, how do I get to the town hall?
formal: Could you please tell me how to get to the town hall?

standard: Excuse me, do you have the time?
formal: Would you be so kind as to tell me the time?

standard: Nice to meet you.
formal: It has been a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

informal: I'm here for you, hang in there.
standard: I'm so sorry for your loss.
formal: Please accept my deepest condolences.

informal: Can I get my money back? It's broken.
standard: I'd like a refund, please.
formal: I should be grateful if you would refund my order.

standard: Could we move the appointment to another day?
formal: I would be grateful if we could reschedule our appointment for a later date.

informal: Bad luck, they didn't pick you.
standard: I'm sorry, but you didn't get the job.
formal: We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful.

informal: Shh, I'm trying to work here!
standard: Could you keep it down? I'm working.
formal: I would appreciate it if you could be quiet, as I am working.

informal: Hi, I'm Ayşe, just joined the team.
standard: Hello, my name is Ayşe and I've just joined the team.
formal: Allow me to introduce myself: I am Ayşe, a recent addition to the team.

standard: I'd like to take a day off tomorrow.
formal: I would like to request a day's leave for tomorrow, if possible.

standard: Could you speak a bit more slowly, please?
formal: Would you be so kind as to speak a little more slowly?

standard: Excuse me, is this seat free?
formal: May I ask whether this seat is available?

standard: Could you tell me the wifi password, please?
formal: Might I ask you for the password to the wifi network?

standard: I'd like you to meet my friend Mehmet.
formal: Allow me to introduce my colleague, Mr Mehmet.

standard: I'd like to book a table for two.
formal: I would like to reserve a table for two at eight o'clock this evening.

tr: geç yanıt verdiğim için kusura bakma
standard: Sorry for replying so late.
formal: Please accept my apologies for the delay in responding.

standard: Good luck for tomorrow!
formal: I wish you every success in your endeavours.

informal: Call me back when you can.
standard: Could you call me back, please?
formal: I would appreciate it if you could return my call at your earliest convenience.

standard: No, thank you, I don't need it.
formal: Thank you, but that will not be necessary.

standard: Happy holidays!
formal: I wish you a most pleasant holiday.

standard: I won't be able to attend the meeting.
formal: Please accept my apologies: I will be unable to attend the meeting.
